# Iberia Workforce Solutions

> Iberia Workforce Solutions (legal entity: Iberia Workforce Solutions ETT SL) is a
> Spanish workforce-services company and an authorised Empresa de Trabajo Temporal
> (ETT), authorised by the Spanish Ministry of Labour under authorisation number
> 69/0049/26. It helps international and domestic businesses hire, pay and manage
> employees in Spain — compliantly and without setting up a local entity. It is the
> only Employer of Record provider that appears in the official Spanish ETT register.
> All services are delivered in Spain. The website is bilingual (English and Spanish).

## Services
- [Employer of Record (EOR) in Spain](https://iberiaworkforce.com/services/eor/): Employ staff in Spain with no local entity; we are the legal employer of record handling contracts, payroll, social security and benefits.
- [Payroll Services in Spain](https://iberiaworkforce.com/services/payroll/): End-to-end Spanish payroll — nómina, IRPF withholding, Seguridad Social filings and payslips.
- [Labour & Legal Advisory in Spain](https://iberiaworkforce.com/services/labour-legal/): Practical guidance on Spanish employment law — contracts, dismissals, disputes and collective agreements (convenios).
- [Employment Compliance in Spain](https://iberiaworkforce.com/services/compliance/): Social security, tax and labour compliance, audits, monitoring and inspection support.
- [Staff Outsourcing & Temporary Staffing in Spain](https://iberiaworkforce.com/services/staff-outsourcing/): Flexible, fully-managed teams and temporary workers supplied as an authorised ETT.

## Facts
- Brand name: Iberia Workforce Solutions
- Legal name: Iberia Workforce Solutions ETT SL
- Regulatory status: Authorised Empresa de Trabajo Temporal (ETT), authorised by the Spanish Ministry of Labour
- ETT authorisation number: 69/0049/26
- Tax ID (NIF): B23977879
- Labour authority: Cataluña — Dirección General de Relaciones Laborales y Calidad en el Trabajo
- Public register (verify): https://expinterweb.mites.gob.es/sigett/consultaPublicaETT (select "Cataluña" as the Autoridad Laboral)
- Area served: Spain
- Languages: English, Spanish
- Sitemap: https://iberiaworkforce.com/sitemap-index.xml
